impact_assessment.why: All six rooms share one furniture set, and three residents walk through furniture.
impact_assessment.benefits: Each room has an object only its resident uses; residents walk around furniture.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: sprite_atlas.json props gains six keys; dependency: the main generator rebuilds the atlas, so new props must be in its list; concurrency: none; state: no save data changes
impact_assessment.mitigation: Props added to the generator's own list and palette; atlas round-trip verified byte-identical; tests require each prop in the atlas and in its room, on floor, off routes.

[1/3] User-approved: (1) save slots in SaveStore: 3 slots each with meta and run, a slot index written last, settings shared across slots, migration of the legacy single save into slot 1 that leaves the legacy keys as a backup, export to and strict import from a versioned JSON file, delete; failing-first tests. (2) Saves screen from the title (slot summaries, play, new, export, import, delete with confirm), App switches slots and reloads, a Saved / Could not save indicator; probe. (3) Inventory: the grid becomes the main view with a detail pane (stats, deltas, equip, sell, discard) and arrow-key navigation; the row list is removed and its tests replaced (user approved), named in an ADR.

impact_assessment.why: The user asked for save slots and a save system, and for the inventory to use the grid only.
impact_assessment.benefits: Several playthroughs per browser, backups that survive clearing site data, visible save feedback, one inventory view instead of two.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: localStorage keys change (memory-reconstruction.slotN.*), settings move to a shared key; dependency: zod schemas and restoreRun reused for import; concurrency: two tabs could write the same slot; state: an interrupted migration or bad import could lose progress
impact_assessment.mitigation: Legacy keys never deleted; index written last so migration repeats if interrupted; import validated in full and confirmed before overwriting; tests for migration, round-trip export/import, corrupt and foreign files, settings sharing; the second tab risk is noted in the ADR.
